Welcome to the Harbor Lights community wiki. This page lists the opening hours of the marina, the fuel dock and the harbor office, along with seasonal changes.

| Facility | Summer | Winter |
|---|---|---|
| Harbor office | 8:00–18:00 | 9:00–16:00 |
| Fuel dock | 7:00–20:00 | closed |
| Pump-out | 24 h | 24 h |

Call the harbor office on channel 16 or by phone during opening hours.
